title: EquivSVA: A Formally Verified Dataset of Behavioral Assertions Across Equivalent RTL Implementations
abstract: arXiv:2609.26751v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to generate SystemVerilog Assertions from natural-language specifica- tions and register-transfer-level designs. Existing datasets and benchmarks support important goals such as large- scale training, formal evaluation, specification-to-assertion generation, and mutation-based testing. A complemen- tary need is to study whether a generated assertion cap- tures externally observable behavior or depends on inci- dental details of one RTL implementation. We present EquivSVA, a formally verified dataset organized around behavior families. Each family contains four structurally distinct RTL implementations of the same externally ob- servable behavior, shared interface-level gold properties, three controlled mutants, and formal-validation evidence. translated_title: EquivSVA：跨等效RTL实现的行为断言形式化验证数据集
translated_abstract: 大语言模型正越来越多地被用于从自然语言规范和寄存器传输级（RTL）设计中生成SystemVerilog断言（SVA）。现有的数据集和基准测试支持诸如大规模训练、形式化评估、规范到断言生成以及基于变异的测试等重要目标。一个互补的需求是：研究生成的断言究竟捕获了外部可观察的行为，还是依赖于某个RTL实现的偶然性细节。我们提出了EquivSVA，一个围绕“行为族”组织的形式化验证数据集。每个行为族包含四个结构不同但具有相同外部可观察行为的RTL实现、共享的接口级黄金属性、三个受控变异体以及形式化验证证据。EquivSVA包含跨12个类别的120个行为族、480个参考RTL实现、914个黄金属性和360个变异体。每个最终的行为族……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: EquivSVA是一个形式化验证的数据集，通过为同一外部可观察行为提供多个结构不同的等效RTL实现及共享黄金属性，用于检验生成的SystemVerilog断言是否真正捕获外部可观察行为，而非依赖特定RTL实现的偶然细节。
en_tdlr: EquivSVA is a formally verified dataset that provides multiple structurally distinct equivalent RTL implementations of the same externally observable behavior along with shared gold properties, enabling the study of whether generated SystemVerilog Assertions capture externally observable behavior rather than incidental details of a particular RTL implementation.
